ps2.7:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati . . . pe . . .
ps2.7:1.2: iti h' idaṃ āyasmato Koṇḍaññassa ‘Aññātakoṇḍañño' tveva nāmaṃ ahosi.
ps2.7:2.1: ‘Idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccan' ti pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi, ñāṇaṃ udapādi, paññā udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādi.
ps2.7:4.6: ime pañca dhammā pañca atthā dukkhavatthukā saccavatthukā saccārammaṇā saccagocarā saccasaṅgahitā saccapariyāpannā sacce samudāgatā sacce ṭhitā sacce patiṭṭhitā.
ps2.7:5.23: ‘taṃ kho pana dhammacakkaṃ appaṭivattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā Mārena vā Brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmin' ti dhammacakkaṃ.
ps2.7:7.1: ‘Ādhipateyyaṭṭhena indriyā dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.2: ‘akampiyaṭṭhena balā dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.3: ‘niyyānaṭṭhena bojjhaṅgā dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.4: ‘hetuṭṭhena maggo dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.5: ‘upaṭṭhānaṭṭhena satipaṭṭhānā dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.6: ‘padahanaṭṭhena sammappadhānā dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.7: ‘ijjhanaṭṭhena iddhipādā dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.8: ‘tathaṭṭhena saccā dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ;
ps2.7:7.9: ‘avikkhepaṭṭhena samatho dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.10: ‘anupassanaṭṭhena vipassanā dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.11: ‘ekarasaṭṭhena samathavipassanā dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.12: ‘anativattanaṭṭhena yuganandhaṃ dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ;
ps2.7:7.13: ‘saṃvaraṭṭhena sīlavisuddhi dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.14: ‘avikkhepaṭṭhena cittavisuddhi dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.15: ‘dassanaṭṭhena diṭṭhivisuddhi dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ;
ps2.7:7.16: ‘muttaṭṭhena vimokkho dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.17: ‘paṭivedhaṭṭhena vijjā dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.18: ‘pariccāgaṭṭhena vimutti dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.19: ‘samucchedaṭṭhena khaye ñāṇaṃ dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.20: ‘paṭippassaddhaṭṭhena anuppāde ñāṇaṃ dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ.
ps2.7:7.21: ‘Chando mūlaṭṭhena dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.22: ‘manasikāro samuṭṭhānaṭṭhena dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.23: ‘phasso samodhānaṭṭhena dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.24: ‘vedanā samosaraṇaṭṭhena dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.25: ‘samādhi pamukkhaṭṭhena dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.26: ‘sati ādhipateyyaṭṭhena dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.27: ‘pañña tatuttaraṭṭhena dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.28: ‘vimutti sāraṭṭhena dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ,
ps2.7:7.29: ‘amatogadhaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyosānaṭṭhena dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ. Paṭis_II,VII.3:
ps2.7:8.1: Taṃ kho pan' idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ pariññeyyan ti . . . pe . . .
ps2.7:8.2: pariññātan ti pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi . . . pe . . .
ps2.7:9.11: ime pañca dhammā pañca atthā dukkhavatthukā saccavatthukā . . . pe . . . sacce patiṭṭhitā.
ps2.7:10.8: ‘amatogadhaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyosānaṭṭhena dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ. Paṭis_II,VII.4:
ps2.7:11.1: ‘Idaṃ dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccan' ti pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi . . . pe . . .
ps2.7:11.3: Taṃ kho pan' idaṃ dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ pahātabban ti . . . pe . . .
ps2.7:11.4: pahīnan ti pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi . . . pe . . .
ps2.7:13.3: ime pañca dhammā pañca atthā samudayavatthukā saccavatthukā . . . pe . . .
ps2.7:13.5: maggavatthukā saccavatthukā saccārammaṇā . . . pe . . . sacce patiṭṭhitā.
ps2.7:14.8: ‘amatogadhaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyosānaṭṭhena dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ. Paṭis_II,VII.5:
ps2.7:15.1: ‘Ayaṃ kāye kāyānupassanā' ti me Bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi . . . pe . . .
ps2.7:15.3: Sā kho panāyaṃ kāye kāyānupassanā bhāvetabbā ti me Bhikkhave . . . pe . . .
ps2.7:15.4: bhāvitā ti me Bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi . . . pe . . .
ps2.7:16.3: ayaṃ dhammesu dhammānupassanā' ti me Bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi . . . pe . . .
ps2.7:16.5: Sā kho panāyaṃ dhammesu dhammānupassanā bhāvetabbā ti me Bhikkhave . . . pe . . .
ps2.7:16.6: bhāvitā ti me Bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi . . . pe . . .
ps2.7:19.3: ime pañca dhammā pañca atthā kāyavatthukā satipaṭṭhānavatthukā . . . pe . . .
ps2.7:19.6: dhammavatthukā satipaṭṭhānavatthukā satipaṭṭhānārammaṇā . . . pe . . . satipaṭṭhāne patiṭṭhitā.
ps2.7:20.8: ‘amatogadhaṃ nibbānaṃ pariyosānaṭṭhena dhammo, taṃ dhammaṃ pavattetīti' dhammacakkaṃ. Paṭis_II,VII.6:
ps2.7:21.1: ‘Ayaṃ chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgato iddhipādo' ti me Bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi . . . pe . . .
ps2.7:21.3: So kho panāyaṃ chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgato iddhipādo bhāvetabbo ti me Bhikkhave . . .
ps2.7:22.3: ayaṃ vīmaṃsāsamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgato iddhipādo' ti me Bhikkhave . . . pe . . .
ps2.7:22.5: So kho panāyaṃ vīmaṃsāsamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgato iddhipādo bhāvetabbo ti me Bhikkhave . . .
ps2.7:25.6: ime pañca dhammā pañca atthā chandavatthukā iddhipādavatthukā iddhipādārammaṇā . . . pe . . . iddhipāde patiṭṭhitā.
ps2.7:30.3: ime pañca dhammā pañca atthā viriyavatthukā iddhipādavatthukā . . . pe . . .
ps2.7:30.5: vīmaṃsāvatthukā iddhipādavatthukā iddhipādārammaṇā . . . pe . . . iddhipāde patiṭṭhitā.
